about: Fictional. A product designer in Oakland, 29. Signs up for a half marathon, gets pulled toward woodworking through late-night videos, drops the race after a knee injury, starts classes, sells a first piece; keeps saying yes to work she doesn't want. Built for F2 (LongMemEval's five abilities). Two automated items are traps: they guess at her inner life and must never be used as evidence about her.

items.content: Signed up for the Oakland half marathon in November. Training plan starts Monday: run Tuesday, Thursday and a long run Saturday.
Calendar event: Run club, Lake Merritt (Tue 7:00am)
First long run, five miles. Knee felt fine.
Skipped the Saturday run. Stayed up till 2am Friday watching videos about leaving tech for woodworking.
Watched: How I quit my design job to become a furniture maker (11:40pm)
Watched: Beginner woodworking: cutting dovetail joints
Another Saturday long run skipped. I always seem to bail on it after a late Friday.
Calendar event: 1:1 with Dana
Dana, my manager, said the promotion is likely in Q1 if the redesign ships. I'm not sure I even want it.
Up late again Friday, skipped the Saturday run.

Email: Your weekly summary
From: Strava <no-reply@strava.com>
You ran 0 miles this week. You seem to be losing motivation!
Knee hurts after Thursday's run. Physio on Monday.
Calendar event: Physio, Dr. Lee
Physio says no running for six weeks. I'm dropping the half marathon. Honestly, relieved.
Calendar event: Woodworking class, Laney College (Sat 10:00am)
Calendar event: Woodworking class, Laney College (Sat 10:00am)
Made my first box at class. Lost track of time completely; four hours felt like twenty minutes.
Watched: Pricing handmade furniture so you actually make money
Calendar event: Dinner with Priya
Calendar event: Woodworking class, Laney College (Sat 10:00am)
Told Priya at dinner I'm thinking about going part-time to make furniture. She asked what I'm afraid of. Money, mostly.

Email: Re: redesign timeline
From: Dana Reyes <dana@studio.example>
Can you own the Q4 launch as well?
Said yes to owning the Q4 launch even though I didn't want it. Again.
Up till 1am sketching a bench. Didn't feel tired at all.
Calendar event: Woodworking class, Laney College (Sat 10:00am)

Email: 5 signs you're burned out (and what to do)
From: Morning Brew <crew@morningbrew.com>
If you're reading this, you might be burned out.
Said yes to judging the internal design awards. Why do I keep saying yes.
Calendar event: Climbing with Priya
Calendar event: Woodworking class, Laney College (Sat 10:00am)
Sold my first piece! A walnut box, $180, to a coworker.

questions.reason: A why is a hypothesis; she asked it herself and hasn't answered. It may be asked back, never stated.
